statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (a b : KdVPlan.Coeff) (am bm : ℕ → KdVPlan.Coeff) (B : ℝ), KdVPlan.MemH s a → KdVPlan.MemH s b → (∀ m, KdVPlan.MemH s (am m) ∧ KdVPlan.MemH s (bm m)) → (∀ ε > 0, ∃ m, ∀ n ≥ m, KdVPlan.hn s (am n-a) < ε ∧ KdVPlan.hn s (bm n-b) < ε) → (∀ m, KdVPlan.hn s (am m-bm m) ≤ B) → KdVPlan.HB s (a-b) B
proof:
intro s a b am bm B ha hb hm hc hB
have submem := @yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_T001 h_T007 h_T011 h_T013
have tri := @yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_T001 h_T007 h_T011 h_T013
refine ⟨(submem s a b ha hb).1, ?_⟩
apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨m, hmc⟩ := hc (ε/2) (by positivity)
have h1 := tri s a (am m) b ha (hm m).1 hb
have h2 := tri s (am m) (bm m) b (hm m).1 (hm m).2 hb
have hs : KdVPlan.hn s (a-am m) = KdVPlan.hn s (am m-a) := by
  unfold KdVPlan.hn
  congr 1
  apply tsum_congr
  intro k
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, norm_sub_rev]
have h3 := hmc m le_rfl
rw [hs] at h1
linarith [hB m]
